schema: CREATE TABLE orders ( order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, total_amount REAL ); CREATE TABLE customer_summary ( customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT );
correct_query: SELECT s.status FROM orders AS o JOIN customer_summary AS s ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount > 100.0;

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT s.status FROM customer_summary AS s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 100.0) AS sub ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id;
